description: Get the full profile of a specific muralist from the Muralists directory: bio, styles, portfolio of realized works with locations, typical project types, and how to request a quote. Use after search_muralists to get details on a candidate.

id.description: The muralist's profile slug — the stable public identifier returned as `id` by search_muralists and used in the profile URL.

name: get_muralist_profile

bio.description: The artist's own statement, in Dutch.

contact_url.description: Where to reach this artist — currently the public profile page.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the artist is based in.

is_pro.description: Active paying member of the directory. Pro profiles rank first.

works.description: Realized murals with location and year.

location.description: City where the mural was realized.

url.description: Absolute URL of the mural's own page, when it has one.

title: Get muralist profile
